name: Friglet
description: Friglet is a Silent Payments (BIP 352) Electrum server for one wallet. Paste the Silent Payments descriptor that Sparrow shows, set the wallet birthday, and connect Sparrow to Friglet to see the payments sent to your sp1 address.
Friglet downloads blocks from this node's Bitcoin Core over the local P2P port. Bitcoin must be fully synced and must not be pruned: the install refuses a pruned node.

Friglet gets tweak data from the BlindBit oracle (https://oracle.setor.dev), a third-party service run by BlindBit. The oracle operator sees this node's IP address, which block ranges are scanned and when. It never sees your keys.
Anyone who can reach Friglet's Electrum port can read this wallet's history. The encrypted port 50032 is open on your local network; the onion address is a Premium feature.
Use a separate Sparrow instance (its own data directory) for this wallet: an Electrum server set in Sparrow applies to every wallet, and Friglet only knows this one.
Uninstalling deletes /mnt/hdd/mynode/blindbit-friglet: the scan key, the wallet settings, the scan progress and the login password.

app_page_content.heading: Connect
content: Web interface: https://{LOCAL_IP_ADDRESS}:{HTTPS_PORT} (log in with the password shown on this page).
Sparrow, on your local network: {LOCAL_IP_ADDRESS}:50032 with SSL on.
Anyone who can reach these ports can read this wallet's history.
